description: A name that resolves to nothing is echoed AS WRITTEN: an UNQUOTED one folded to upper case, a QUOTED one verbatim with its quotes and its case intact. The distinction is not decoration - "a" and A are different columns, so echoing the folded name for a quoted reference names a column the user never wrote and reports the opposite of what went wrong. The echo holds in every clause that reports an unresolvable reference, SELECT list, WHERE and GROUP BY alike, and the quoted name that DOES match still reads: the column is A, so "A" is the way to it. Converted 1:1 from query/QuotedIdentifierEchoTest (now retired).
